execution: One city at a time on this 8 GiB Mac. Close owned component tabs before loading a full city. Record provider and graphics setting. Abort an unresponsive run; never mark it passed.
steps: Start from a fresh menu and record time to first controllable frame.
Use daylight. Save an overview and a walking-height view.
Walk forward, return, turn around, then inspect the same curb and frontage again.
Check an intersection corner, a sloping frontage, a missing-building gap, and a grade-separated crossing where present; record absent cases as not applicable.
Capture terrain, sidewalk and road heights plus rendered layer ownership at any defect.
Inspect memory before and after the route, with worker/queue status. Stop the world before the next city.

acceptance.geometry: No non-finite or downward triangles; sampled pavement stays above terrain; protected areas remain excluded; render/contact agree.
acceptance.visibility: Raised pavement remains visible across camera positions; no depth-biased hardscape overlays.
acceptance.visual: No unaccounted frontage gaps, spikes or discontinuous corners in the route screenshots.
acceptance.performance: No UI timeouts. Record load time, JS heap and geometry bytes separately; any unresponsive run is a failure, not a skipped success.
